ModMetaData.name: Prison Labor Reachability Fix
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description: Prison Labor scans cell-based work (roof removal, cleaning, smoothing, ...) by distance only, so a prisoner can be assigned a target it cannot path to and then repeats that failing job instead of doing reachable work. This patch adds the reachability check vanilla 1.7 performs before choosing a work cell: only cells the prisoner can actually reach become job targets. Thing-based work is untouched, and the fix disables itself if Prison Labor is absent or its scan method changes.
